newsitem.title: GERMANY: European Monetary Institute meeting concludes.
newsitem.headline: European Monetary Institute meeting concludes.

text.p: The monthly meeting of the European Monetary Institute (EMI) has concluded, an EMI spokesperson said.

The meeting, attended by 15 governors of the European Union member nations' central banks and the EMI president Alexandre Lamfalussy, was addressed by Irish Finance Minister Ruairi Quinn. Ireland currently holds the presidency of the European Union.
Quinn said on the fringes of the meeting that, "the overall climate for Irish interest rates is extremely positive, it is maybe the best it has been in 25 years." --Frankfurt Newsroom + 49 69 756525
